  "recovered_c": "uint fn_08(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  if (len == 0) {\n    return 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF;\n  }\n  uint32_t result = 0xFFFFFFFF;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    result ^= in[i];\n    for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {\n      result = -(result & 1) & 0xf7179bf5 ^ result >> 1;\n    }\n  }\n  return ~result;\n}"
